description: The sea ice configuration in NorESM3 is based on CICE6.6.3 (https://zenodo.org/records/18434619). It is configured with EVP dynamics, 5 sea ice thickness distribution categories, and multilayer snow and ice thermodynamics. Albedo and shortwave absorption are modelled by a Delta-Eddington approach utilizing prognostic snow grain size metamorphosis, melt ponds, and aerosols.
